title: Fun(ctions)
body: After learning about them in Data $$8$$, Tim wants to write a function that can calculate the hypotenuse of any right triangle. He wants to use his function to assign C to the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs (sides adjacent to the hypotenuse) A and B. However, he’s made many mistakes. Which ones can you identify?\n##figure1.gif

figureAlts.figure1.gif: A function defined as hypotenuse with arguments a and b. Inside the function, squares is set to make_array with side1 and side2, multiplied by 2. Sum is set to the sum of squares. Squareroot is set to the square root of sum using np.sqrt. The function prints squareroot. Below, C is assigned the result of hypotenuse with arguments A and B, with a comment indicating C should be the numerical result.
